final: WITH valid_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT Examination.ID FROM Examination WHERE Examination."ANA Pattern" != 'S' AND Examination.ID IS NOT NULL) SELECT Examination.ID, Patient.SEX, AVG(Examination."aCL IgM") as avg_acl_igm FROM Examination JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Examination.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM valid_ids) GROUP BY Examination.ID, Patient.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_acl_igm IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10
